answer: Locks are logged in vertex, expire in falcon, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 81 aliases thus needs 38 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4283 identities would post 4295 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
